# Frostrek AI - Comprehensive Knowledge Base

> Frostrek AI delivers production-ready autonomous AI agents, LLM training, customized applications, workflow automation, and data annotation services for enterprises and frontier AI teams.

## About Frostrek AI
Founded in 2019, Frostrek AI is a global enterprise AI software company. We partner with leading organizations to build next-generation agentic solutions, automating complex workflows with unmatched speed, accuracy, and security filters. From planning workflows to orchestrating hundreds of parallel agents, our systems scale seamlessly on auto-scaling clusters.

## Why Frostrek AI (Differentiators)
- **Enterprise-Grade Focus**: We don't just build chatbots; we build autonomous systems with strict zero-trust security (ISO 27001, SOC 2 Type II, GDPR, HIPAA compliant).
- **Global Presence**: Headquartered in Gurugram, India, with offices in Austin, TX, and London, UK.
- **Human-in-the-Loop Experts**: We combine frontier AI models with expert data annotation and human-in-the-loop oversight to ensure 99.9% accuracy in mission-critical applications.
- **Omnichannel Deployment**: Seamless deployment across Web, WhatsApp, Messenger, and bespoke enterprise tools.
- **Scale and Experience**: Over 5,000+ training sessions delivered, 200+ AI specialists, and 50+ enterprise clients served globally.

## Core Products

### Frosty Agent
An omnichannel intelligent agent for support and sales. 
- **Features**: Connects securely to enterprise knowledge bases (Notion, Zendesk, internal wikis), deploys instantly to Website and WhatsApp, and handles complex multi-turn conversations with RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation).

### Hiyring
A next-generation AI recruitment and hiring platform.
- **Features**: Conducts autonomous video interviews, provides unbiased candidate scoring, anti-fraud tracking, and auto-generates comprehensive technical assessments.

### Vedashi
Premium, hyper-personalized online storefronts optimized for conversational commerce.
- **Features**: Features intelligent WhatsApp cart recovery, dynamic catalog presentation, and hyper-personalized recommendations powered by real-time behavioral data.

### VettEdge
AI-powered resume parsing and candidate vetting system.
- **Features**: Deep semantic matching between job descriptions and candidate profiles, integrates natively into existing HR and ATS workflows, reducing screening time by up to 80%.

## Enterprise Solutions

### AI Agents
End-to-end intelligent agent development for internal workflows. We build autonomous workers capable of accessing APIs, managing databases, and executing multi-step business logic securely.

### Manufacturing Intelligence
AI-driven operational intelligence. We digitize shift handovers and quality capture, replacing unstructured WhatsApp communication with strictly typed, actionable structured data for ERPs.

### Voice AI
Enterprise-grade AI calling agents. Capable of handling complex regional dialects, low-latency conversational turns, and high-volume outbound/inbound call centers.

### Custom LLM Fine-Tuning & Data Annotation
Managed RLHF alignment, red-teaming, and dataset preparation services. We specialize in medical, legal, and financial domain-specific tuning utilizing human-in-the-loop validation for frontier AI developers.

### Web3 & Fintech
Custom fintech wallets, closed-loop loyalty systems, and smart-contract integrated payment gateways.

### Multivendor Dashboard
Centralized management and analytics software tailored for multivendor ecommerce platforms.

## Industries & Use Cases
- **Ecommerce & Retail**: Automated customer support, conversational commerce, and WhatsApp cart recovery.
- **Manufacturing & Industrial**: Digital shift handovers, operational intelligence, defect tracking, and IoT data structuring.
- **Fintech & Web3**: Secure custom wallets, loyalty programs, and crypto-integrated payment gateways.
- **HR & Recruitment**: Autonomous video interviewing and AI resume parsing.
- **Healthcare & Legal**: Managed data annotation and RLHF with strict privacy protocols for domain-specific LLM training.

## Security & Compliance
We enforce a Zero-Trust architecture across all client deployments.
- **Certifications**: ISO 27001, ISO 9001, SOC 2 Type II
- **Compliance**: Fully GDPR and HIPAA compliant workflows
- **Deployment Options**: Cloud-native (AWS/GCP), Private VPC, or On-Premise deployments available for sensitive workloads.
